issues.title: [Feature request] Resident-world support and mod API for seamless inter-level portals
issues.author: noire342
issues.body:
I'm working on a Ratchet & Clank PAL mod that connects planets through ordinary doorways. The goal is to see the destination with the correct perspective and walk through continuously, without a loading screen or fade.
I have a working prototype using local engine changes based on OpenRAC 0.10.0. I'd like to discuss the reusable engine support needed to eventually run this through the official client.
The main capabilities are:

Keep multiple levels resident, with independent objects,…
